name: Swamp
desc: Being slowed down and watched - a place that does not want you moving through it.
tags: scenery, no humans, swamp, cypress trees, hanging moss, still black water, half submerged roots, duckweed on water, rotting logs, low mist, dead branches, water reflection
prose: a swamp of cypress trunks standing in still black water, hanging moss on the branches, roots and rotting logs half submerged, a skin of duckweed across the surface and low mist between the trees
note: Renders as an ordinary flooded forest unless the water SURFACE is described - duckweed, still black water and reflection are what separate a swamp from a wet wood. Hanging moss and buttressed roots carry the whole mood. Eerie and foreboding are the classic wasted words here; they measurably do nothing, and the dread has to come from moonlit or night.
